title: Market-sizing methodology: WSTS vs Gartner vs other publishers
why_it_matters: Headline market size differs by publisher and vintage; the atlas must state which population each number measures.
questions: How exactly do WSTS, Gartner, Omdia, TechInsights and IDC define and compute the semiconductor market?
How are foundry revenue, captive/custom chips, distribution resale and memory price swings treated?
Why did Gartner's 2024 estimate move from US$626bn to US$655.9bn?

title: Foundry market: definitions (pure-play vs Foundry 2.0), size and shares
why_it_matters: Foundry is the core manufacturing layer for fabless firms and its size depends heavily on definition.
questions: What are the pure-play, total foundry and Foundry 2.0 market sizes 2020-2025?
Who are the top foundries and their shares under each definition?
primary_sources: TSMC, UMC, GlobalFoundries, SMIC annual reports

title: Semiconductor manufacturing equipment: segments, size and geography
why_it_matters: Equipment is a separately measured US$135bn market whose segmentation (lithography, deposition, etch, test, etc.) is not yet mapped.
questions: What are SEMI's 22+ equipment segments and their sizes?
How do front-end vs back-end equipment and new vs refurbished equipment differ?

title: Semiconductor materials: segments and suppliers
why_it_matters: US$73bn materials market (wafers, photoresist, gases, substrates) is a separate layer with its own concentration risks.
questions: What are the SEMI materials sub-segments and sizes?
Which materials are most geographically concentrated?

title: EDA and semiconductor IP market
why_it_matters: EDA/IP is small in revenue but a critical chokepoint; ESD Alliance measures it separately.
questions: What is the annual ESD market and its categories?
Which firms dominate EDA and IP licensing?

title: Assembly, test and advanced packaging (OSAT and in-house)
why_it_matters: Back-end is measured inconsistently (OSAT revenue vs Foundry 2.0 vs equipment) and advanced packaging is central to AI chips.
questions: How large is the OSAT market and who leads it?
How is advanced packaging defined and measured?

title: End-market segmentation and the 2025-2026 AI/memory surge
why_it_matters: WSTS forecasts 90% growth in 2026 driven by memory; end-use shares are shifting fast towards computing/AI.
questions: What are the exact WSTS end-use shares for 2023-2025?
How much of 2025-2026 growth is price vs volume, and AI vs other?

title: Official statistics mapping: NAICS, ISIC/NACE, HS codes and their limits
why_it_matters: Government data (production, employment, trade) use broader classifications than industry bodies; the atlas needs a crosswalk.
questions: What do US NAICS 334413 and 333242, NACE 26.11 and HS 8541/8542/8486 cover exactly?
Which official datasets are usable for size, employment and trade, and with what caveats?

title: Boundary industries: displays, solar PV, passive components, PCBs and EMS
why_it_matters: These use semiconductor-like processes or share classifications but are excluded from the semiconductor market; scope decisions must be explicit.
questions: Which adjacent industries share processes, equipment or classifications with semiconductors?
How large are they and should any be in scope?
